visual.primary_reading_route: signal reliability -> customer exposure -> recovery options -> exception -> next move

core_units.visual_teaches: What to verify before treating a changed date or quantity as an actionable risk.
Why an observed supplier signal and a customer commitment are separate questions.
How to make remaining options and unknowns visible before claiming a recovery plan.

caption.job: Add why this distinction matters in a live exception, one bounded example or caveat, and a discussion question. Do not narrate the three checks again.
adds: Why teams confuse an unreliable signal with confirmed customer exposure.
The boundary: escalate uncertainty rather than inventing a recovery date.
One meeting question that helps the reader apply the reference.
must_not_repeat: The full on-visual module labels or their explanatory sentences, unless a named repeat has a clear reason.

hook.job: Name the reader's unresolved moment without summarising every module.
hook.why_this_mode: The visual contains the reusable answer; the opening earns attention through the unresolved decision. A direct hook is also allowed when it is clearer.

review.notes: A duplicate warning is a review prompt, not an automatic rejection. Record intentional repeats by unit ID and explain why the caption needs them.
